entries.what: Toggl Track API v8 is switched off.

source.quote: The deprecated /api/v8/* endpoints will be disabled starting on April 1 2023.

lookFor: A request to toggl.com/api/v8/... on any subdomain
requires: Paths differ: for example /api/v8/time_entries/current is /api/v9/me/time_entries/current, and it returns the entry itself rather than { data }.
